claims.statement: The EU Data Act requires connected-product and related-service data, including relevant metadata, to be accessible to users in a structured machine-readable form under its conditions.
European Commission guidance explicitly identifies industrial and agricultural machinery as connected products whose users can access and share generated data for new services.

contrary_evidence: Data access does not create a warranty remedy, and many useful derived diagnostics or trade-secret data may remain outside scope.

structure.control_point: The user-controlled, tamper-evident operating record linked to warranty and invoice outcomes
structure.critical_dependency: Access to raw connected-product data and contracts that define measurable remedies

thesis: Give industrial-equipment users and lessors a neutral edge record of run state, fault codes, maintenance response and contract exclusions. When uptime, output or repair-time commitments fail, generate the warranty or lease-adjustment packet and reconcile the credit, rent reduction or service bonus. Equipment-finance firms and maintenance distributors provide one-to-many distribution; verified resolutions build model-specific failure and enforceability curves.
